meta.purpose: Development scientific contract for DisasterTrace v17; items updated based on V17-03 census results and G1 gate assessment
meta.candidate_contribution: A benchmark for distinguishing operational evidence maintenance from probabilistic forecasting skill under real weather-product revisions
meta.statistical_power_note_updated: V17-03 census revealed 121,885 pre-deadline evidence changes across 17,064 slots (vs. 36 checkpoints in pilot selection). This answers the G1 evidence-existence question (sufficient TAF-side volume: YES) but NOT the Codex statistical-power concern about H15's positive-label rate. Evidence-change volume and positive-label rate are distinct: the census is Y-blind by design and cannot measure how often TAF changes correlate with outcome-label differences. The Codex concern (3/36 = 8.33% positive rate in pilot) remains open and requires a future outcome-side (Y-permissioned) analysis before the H15 paired-diagnostic experiment's results can be trusted. See TRANSITION_CENSUS_v17.md Scope Clarification section.
meta.g1_reverification_note: Batch A2 (2026-09-21) found the V17-03 PASSED determination relied on measurements it did not actually perform: the census filtered on issued_at < target_start rather than per-checkpoint available_at (T-60/T-40/T-20 fields were computed but never consumed), 'zero dispute rate' read entry.get('tie_unresolved') -- a field compile_ledger() never emits -- and 4,264 station-day groups were reported as independent processes without a lineage/adjacency justification. See correction_history below and PLAN/BATCH_A2_PROGRESS.md for the active reverification work.

correction_history.withdrawn_claim_verbatim: PASSED - proceed with H15 as scoped
correction_history.reason_for_withdrawal: Original V17-03 claimed 121,885 evidence changes 'substantively addressed' the Codex statistical-power (positive-label) concern. This conflated an X-side (TAF evidence volume) measurement with a Y-side (outcome positive-label rate) question; the census is Y-blind by design and structurally cannot answer it.

correction_history.withdrawn_claim_verbatim: PASSED - proceed with H15 as scoped
correction_history.reason_for_withdrawal: Independent review (three reviews, findings merged) found the PASSED determination unsupported even for the narrower evidence-existence question: (1) census never consumed the T-60/T-40/T-20 checkpoint fields, so '98% coverage' does not demonstrate per-checkpoint availability; (2) the 'zero dispute rate' read a field the ledger never populates, so it could not have detected any conflict; (3) 4,264 station-day groups were reported as independent weather processes without justification. Status changed to PENDING_REVERIFICATION pending Batch A2 fixes (checkpoint-aware classification, propagated tie/relation status, separated count units).

C01_primary_domain.value_or_spec: H15 airport low-visibility: routine observation visibility threshold events at fixed stations, specifically IEM routine unique-hour reports
open_details: Per-checkpoint (T-60/T-40/T-20) evidence availability, not just issued_at < target_start (Batch A2-3)
Conflict/dispute detection actually wired to the ledger's relation status, not a field the ledger never emits (Batch A2-2)
Independence justification for station-day process groups, or an honest 'candidate grouping, independence unverified' label (Batch A2-3)
withdrawn_details: Real transition density: 121,885 pre-deadline changes across 17,064 slots (98% coverage) -- WITHDRAWN: filter was issued_at < target_start, not checkpoint-aware (available_at vs T-60/T-40/T-20); reported denominator also conflated the 17,078 evidence-eligible slot count with the 17,420 full-calendar slot count.

TAF-side classification consistency: 0% dispute rate in AMD/COR/mirror classification (ledger semantics verified) -- WITHDRAWN: census read entry.get('tie_unresolved'), a field compile_ledger() never populates; a 0% rate under this check could not have detected any real conflict.

Independent weather processes: 4,264 station-day groups, sufficient for block inference -- WITHDRAWN: grouping key is (station, issue UTC day) only; no lineage/adjacency analysis was performed to establish independence.
C01_primary_domain.open_details_note: Outcome-label reliability (ASOS-derived Y labels) remains PENDING_HUMAN_VERIFICATION per LABEL_QUALIFICATION_v17.md and is a SEPARATE question from TAF source-label qualification (see OR1c). Neither is currently closed.

withdrawn_details: Census verified: 98% of slots have TAF evidence available before T-60 -- WITHDRAWN: census measured issued_at < validity_start (target window start), never checked availability specifically at or before T-60.

T-60/T-40/T-20 checkpoints fall within legal exposure (issued_at < validity_start filter) -- WITHDRAWN: checkpoint offsets were computed by compute_checkpoints() but classify_changes_for_slot() never consumed them.

17,064 slots with pre-deadline changes demonstrate checkpoint feasibility -- WITHDRAWN: 'issued before target start' is not the same claim as 'available at a specific scoring checkpoint'; a product issued 10 minutes before target start is counted even though invisible at all three checkpoints.

registered_profile_A2_4.note: The single outcome profile manifest.py/outcome_wiring.py enforce end-to-end as of Batch A2-4. Registered here so this contract document and the code's H15_DEFAULT_PROFILE cannot silently diverge. Any outcome_contract that differs in any field raises UnsupportedOutcomeProfile in build_manifest() and (for v2-schema manifests) in build_episode_manifest_v16.py's run_disclose() before any ASOS/outcome data path is constructed. A v1-schema manifest (no outcome_contract field) takes an explicit legacy_v1 branch using the same values below.

amd_cor_vs_probability_change.description: The existence of an AMD/COR product does NOT automatically mean probability must change. These are separately falsifiable propositions.

amd_cor_vs_probability_change.probability_change: A probability change may be warranted by unchanged evidence (new inference) or may not be warranted by changed evidence (unchanged conclusion)

OR1a_positive_label_distribution.description: Original Codex concern: in the 12-target pilot, only 3/36 (8.33%) checkpoint-rows were positive, and all 3 rows corresponded to a single KDEN event (not independent occurrences). The actual Y=1 distribution and unique positive-event count across the full allowed calendar remain unmeasured.
OR1a_positive_label_distribution.why_not_resolved_by_census: Evidence-change volume (TAF-side, X-dependent) and positive-label rate (outcome-side, Y-dependent) are distinct metrics. A Y-blind census cannot measure this regardless of how large the X-side count is.
OR1a_positive_label_distribution.required_resolution: A future outcome-side (Y-permissioned) analysis measuring positive-label rate and unique positive-event count across the full allowed calendar. Out of scope for Batch A/A2.
OR1a_positive_label_distribution.does_not_block: C3/X3 equivalent-repetition drift diagnostics -- see OR1_note_y_free_diagnostics_exception below.
blocker_for: Final H15 paired-diagnostic experiment interpretation for outcome-dependent claims (C1, C4)

OR1b_independent_process_and_pairing_pre.description: Codex's core concern was non-independence / block correlation across a small, repeated cohort (the same weather event recurring across checkpoints, targets, and stations), not merely a low percentage. Census candidate groupings (station-day) do not by themselves establish independent-process count or resulting pairing precision for any experiment.
OR1b_independent_process_and_pairing_pre.required_resolution: G3 development-variance estimation and G5 confirmation-precision work must characterize cross-target/cross-station/cross-day correlation before block-inference or sample-size claims can be made.
blocker_for: Any claim that groups constitute independent samples

OR1c_taf_source_label_qualification.description: LABEL_QUALIFICATION_v17.md's PENDING_HUMAN_VERIFICATION status refers to TAF-side AMD/COR classification and lineage (predecessor) labels -- it does NOT refer to ASOS outcome Y labels. Prior contract/status documents mis-cited this as outcome-label reliability pending; that citation is corrected here. TAF source-label qualification is independent of, and does not require, Y access.
OR1c_taf_source_label_qualification.required_resolution: Independent human review of the Batch A2-7 witness package (target 24-32 items) covering TAF source-relationship judgments. Recorded as PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW until a reviewer is available.
OR1c_taf_source_label_qualification.owner: Independent reviewer (not currently online; dependency registered in Batch A2)
blocker_for: Treating TAF AMD/COR/lineage classifications as verified rather than provisional

open_risks.OR1_note_y_free_diagnostics_exception: R2/C3-style equivalent-repetition drift diagnostics (experiment X3) do NOT require Y and are NOT blocked by OR1a. They require qualified/diverse parent states, lawful equivalent perturbation, and paired repetition with correct dependency handling -- see CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MATRIX_v17.md C3 row and OR1b. OR1a's Y-dependency must not be read as a blanket precondition for all H15 paired-diagnostic experiments; blocking is per-experiment, not project-wide.
